# EM9: Animal Welfare

**Display ID:** EM9  
**Pillar:** Environmental Criteria  
**Points:** 1  
**Mandatory for Certification:** Yes  
**Category:** Environmental Impact Reduction and Transparency  
**Applicability:** Project, Designing Entity  
**Project types:** Print, Digital, Hybrid  
**Related SDGs:** SDG 13, SDG 14, SDG 15

## Summary
Protects all animals.

## Criteria
To the best of the design entity's knowledge, the project, the design entity, and the client's activities do not, and will not, put animals at risk.

## Why it matters
Animals are not at risk from this project.

## Extended guidance
#### Where can I read the declaration and what it’s about?

The Universal Declaration on Animal Welfare (UDAW) is a proposed inter-governmental agreement to recognise that animals are sentient, to prevent cruelty and reduce suffering, and to promote standards on the welfare of animals such as farm animals, companion animals, animals in scientific research, draught animals, wildlife and animals in recreation. This Declaration is proposed by the World Society for the Protection of Animals.
Read it on [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Universal_Declaration_on_Animal_Welfare).

#### What will be the working definition of “animal”?

How complex does the organism need to be before we will consider it worthy of risk-aversion? A living organism that feeds on organic matter, typically having specialized sense organs and nervous system and able to respond rapidly to stimuli.

#### Does ‘animal’ include humans?

In the case of this criterion, human animals are not included.
